knowledgeBlocks.blockName: Step1-理财产品基本信息插入临时表
knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode:
INSERT INTO CDM.VT_C_PRD_FIN_SYS_PROD_INF_01
SELECT TPR.prod_no, COALESCE(TPR.prod_class_cd, TTA.prod_class_cd), TPR.ta_cd,
       TTA.ta_abre, TTA.ta_name, TTA.recon_mode_cd,
       TPR.prod_name, TPR.prod_alias, TPR.prod_net_val,
       CASE WHEN TPR.net_val_dt = 0 THEN DATE 'MIN_DATE' ... END AS net_val_dt,
       TPR.net_val_days, TPR.prod_face_val, TPR.inter_reve_fee_rate,
       ... (日期处理字段) ...,
       NVL(TPV.field_val, PFR.INTER_REVE_FEE_RATE) AS fee_rate,
       TPR.ctrl_flag, TPR.evalu_lvl_cd, TPR.prod_cumul_net_val,
       TPR.prod_mgmt_person, TPR.template_desc
  FROM FDM.F_PD_WMNS_PROD_INF TPR
  LEFT JOIN FDM.F_PD_WMNS_TA_PROD_INF TTA
         ON TPR.ta_cd = TTA.ta_cd
        AND TTA.end_dt > DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}' AND TTA.start_dt <= DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}'
  LEFT JOIN FDM.F_PD_WMNS_PROD_INF_EXT_INF TPV
         ON TPR.prod_no = TPV.prod_no
        AND TPV.field_cd = 'prd_remark'
        AND TPV.end_dt > DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}' AND TPV.start_dt <= DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}'
  LEFT JOIN (子查询取F_SP_PFMA_PROD_FEE_RATE_ADDIT_RECOR中最新的费率) PFR
         ON TPR.PROD_NO = PFR.PROD_CD
 WHERE TPR.end_dt > DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}' AND TPR.start_dt <= DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}'
knowledgeBlocks.tracedSqlCode:
INSERT INTO CDM.VT_C_PRD_FIN_SYS_PROD_INF_01
SELECT TPR.prd_code AS prod_no, COALESCE(TPR.prd_type, TTA.prd_type) AS prod_class_cd,
       TPR.ta_code AS ta_cd, TTA.ta_shortname AS ta_abre, TTA.ta_name,
       TTA.comp_mode AS recon_mode_cd, TPR.prd_name, TPR.prd_name2 AS prod_alias,
       TPR.nav AS prod_net_val, ... (净值日期处理) ...,
       TPR.nav_days AS net_val_days, TPR.face_value AS prod_face_val,
       TPR.iss_price AS inter_reve_fee_rate, ... (日期处理字段) ...,
       NVL(TPV.field_value, PFR.rate) AS fee_rate,
       TPR.control_flag AS ctrl_flag, TPR.grade AS evalu_lvl_cd,
       TPR.tot_nav AS prod_cumul_net_val, TPR.prd_manager AS prod_mgmt_person,
       TPR.model_comment AS template_desc
  FROM ODM.O_WMNS_TBPRODUCT TPR
  LEFT JOIN ODM.O_WMNS_TBTAINFO TTA ON TPR.ta_code = TTA.ta_code
  LEFT JOIN ODM.O_WMNS_TBPRDPARAMVALUE TPV
         ON TPR.prd_code = TPV.prd_code AND TPV.field_code = 'prd_remark'
  LEFT JOIN (子查询取O_PFMA_RECORD_MONEY_MANAGE中最新的费率rate) PFR
         ON TPR.prd_code = PFR.prd_code

knowledgeBlocks.blockName: Step2-向主表插入数据并补充产品到期信息
knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode:
INSERT INTO CDM.C_PRD_FIN_SYS_PROD_INF
SELECT DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}', T01.*,
       CASE WHEN T01.prod_rmk = 'B102' THEN TTA.end_date
            WHEN T01.prod_rmk = 'D309' AND T01.ta_cd <> 'Y70' THEN TTC.trans_date
            WHEN T01.prod_rmk IN ('1300','1301','D309') AND T01.ta_cd = 'Y70' THEN TTD.trans_date
            ELSE T01.prod_end_dt END AS prod_expir_dt
  FROM CDM.VT_C_PRD_FIN_SYS_PROD_INF_01 T01
  LEFT JOIN (子查询取F_PD_WMNS_PROD_PROGM_INF中cycle_type_cd='1'且alw_type_cd='1'最近到期日) TTA ON T01.prod_no=TTA.prod_no
  LEFT JOIN (子查询取F_CO_WMNS_PROD_WORKD_SET中dt_type_cd='7'最近工作日) TTC ON T01.prod_no=TTC.prod_no
  LEFT JOIN (子查询取F_CO_WMNS_PROD_WORKD_SET中dt_type_cd='5'最近工作日) TTD ON T01.prod_no=TTD.prod_no

knowledgeBlocks.businessScenario: 理财系统产品信息-根据产品方案信息和产品工作日设置补充三种口径的产品到期日期
knowledgeBlocks.sqlFunction: 多表关联查询+业务规则判断
knowledgeBlocks.tableJoinLogic: 以临时表为主表，根据产品备注(prod_rmk)字段分三种口径：B102→取产品方案到期日(cycle_type_cd='1'且允许赎回alw_type_cd='1')，D309代销→取产品工作日设置(dt_type_cd='7')，1300/1301/D309自营(ta_cd='Y70')→取产品工作日设置(dt_type_cd='5')
knowledgeBlocks.queryDimensions: 产品编号、产品类别代码、TA代码、TA简称、产品名称、产品净值、净值日期、产品面值、募集日期、成立日期、到期日、产品属性、风险等级、产品状态、费率、控制标志、评估等级、累计净值、产品管理人、业绩比较基准
